connectionScope: Management connections, authentication and configuration results for this account's devices.
deviceNamesUnavailable: Device names are temporarily unavailable. Logs remain available by device ID.
scope: Runtime events from the management service. See Device connection logs for individual device activity.
retention: Service started: {{started}} · Keeps the latest {{capacity}} entries · {{dropped}} entries discarded. Logs are held in memory and cleared on restart.
restarted: The server restarted. Showing the latest logs from the current service instance.
restricted: Server logs are available to authorized administrators. You can still view device connection logs for your account.
searchPlaceholder: Search messages and fields, up to 128 characters
loadFailed: Check that the server supports the logs module, or refresh to try again.
empty: No logs in this service instance yet
olderEmpty: No older entries remain. Return to the latest logs.
